title: Bendy's Music Discs
description: This resource pack add music from  Bendy and the Ink Machine
body:
Bendy Music Discs is a themed resource pack that replaces Minecraft’s standard music discs with iconic tracks inspired by the worlds of *Bendy and the Ink Machine* and *Bendy and the Dark Revival*. The resource pack completely replaces the music on existing in-game discs but does not add any new items to the game. Disclaimer: This is strictly a non-commercial fan project created for the community.
